title: Sources & further reading
body:
Entry rules: Embassy of Uruguay in the US. Health: CDC Uruguay traveler page. Transit fares/schedules: COT.

Sights: Palacio Salvo guided tours (Red Ticket), Faro de Colonia, Museo del Carnaval hours & admission (Uruguay Ministry of Education and Culture, Feb 2026), Casapueblo, Isla de Lobos, Colonia's combined museum ticket. The Laguna Garzón operator's own site (lagunagarzon.uy) is currently unreachable — confirm it directly before planning around it.

Food: El Palenque, Bodega Bouza, Lo de Silverio. Carnival: Desfile de Llamadas (Intendencia de Montevideo) — check for the 2027 dates closer to the trip; they were not yet posted as of this check.
